bg_ptp.definition: peak-to-peak range of per-frame Gray8 means

bg_rms.definition: population RMS of per-frame Gray8 means around their temporal mean

cma_admission.limitation: kernel CMA accounting and verified DDR safety envelope only; not a measured CMA interval or static CMA subregion; authoritative PYNQ physical-address, size, overlap and allocation accounting checks remain mandatory

component_area_histogram.definition: exact area frequency for connected components surviving min_area

gray_background_statistics.source: exact WO-0016 pipeline Gray8: camera channel 0, nearest-neighbor 640x400 to 320x240; not a separately computed luminance conversion

notes: The board raw status is preserved unchanged in the companion board-raw JSON.
The raw gate field frame_count_100 is a legacy name; the deployed sampler required and processed 115 frames, and its value reflects that configured frame-count check.
The configured Stage B-1 FPS gate measures frame delivery. The separate runner end-to-end rate is 13.209 FPS, below the nominal 15.15 FPS target; treat full-run throughput as a review item.
Sidecar paths in this normalized copy point to local files; original board paths are retained in path_on_board.

note: Measured only for the supplied finite live-camera interval; no automatic retry/reset/reload.

optical_luminance_statistics.pipeline_relationship: measured separately from the exact Gray8 channel passed to PL; it does not replace the DMA input
